content.short: Crypto exchange with 41 million users, known for its XRP focus and staking offers.
content.description: Bitrue has operated since 2018 and reports 41 million registered users and more than 1,200 listed coins. Beyond spot trading it offers USDT, USDC and coin-margined futures, trading bots, flexible staking with a strong XRP following, and TradFi pairs that let users trade US stocks, forex and metals using USDT from the same account.
content.meta: Bitrue offers spot, futures, staking and USDT-settled stock and forex trading to 41M users, with a big XRP community.
